instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html title with 'Școala Gimnazială Konsza Samu • Nagybacon | Bățanii Mari'
3. Set CSS variables for warm stone palette (#FAF7F2 base, #1C1917 text, #9A3412 terracotta accent, #1E3A2F forest secondary) as specified in surfaces.
4. Implement a bilingual language context provider with persisted state ('ro' / 'hu') and complete dictionary for all UI text, allowing smooth instant language toggling without full reload.
5. Seed the backend with at least 6 rich bilingual articles celebrating school events, folklore days, sports competitions, and academic milestones in Nagybacon/Bățanii Mari.
6. Build the full Admin CMS panel allowing the headmaster/teachers to write new posts in both Romanian and Hungarian, edit existing articles, and view contact submissions.
7. Include all testing attributes (data-testid='...') across navigation links, language switches, form inputs, submit buttons, and admin actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle paper grain textures.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) with warm tinting.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for transform and opacity.
Never use AI assistant emoji icons (🤖, 🧠, 💡). Use lucide-react glyphs or custom crafted SVGs.
Main agent relies on the provided curated Unsplash URLs for school and regional imagery.
